formMaker.total: Overview

elstyleSaver.innerContent:
The purpose of this form is to help you obtain network/computer access for a new person starting work at OCC. If the person does not need any type of computer access, this form is not necessary.

The personal information (date of birth and address) is required so that IT can validate the person’s identity if they should need their password reset.
